logo_override.validation_detail: svg 9835 bytes, probed HTTP 200 with content-type image/svg+xml (Adobe Illustrator 22.0.1 export, SVG 1.1). The file carries no fill attributes at all, so the brief's 'check SVG fill attributes' test is uninformative here and I resolved it by rendering instead: decoded to a data URL and rendered on a white background, it shows the university's full mark - the blue circular flame-and-torch device beside 'Tecnologico de Monterrey' set in blue serif. Blue on transparency, clearly legible on a light card.

notes: Awarding body is Tecnologico de Monterrey, so a Tec mark is correct. IMPORTANT TRAP, worth flagging wave-wide: https://tec.mx/themes/custom/tec/logo.svg probes as HTTP 200 image/svg+xml and is therefore a textbook rule-4 'verified' asset by content type alone - but it is a 278-byte Drupal placeholder stub whose entire body is a grey <rect fill="#f0f0f0"> plus <text>Image Not Found</text>. Rendering it on white shows literally the words 'Image Not Found'. Rejected. This is the clearest case in my shard where probing status and content type is not sufficient and the render is mandatory. Discovery route: the record's own page https://tec.mx/es/profesional/becas/internacional is slow (it exceeded a 45s navigation timeout and eventually loaded at /es/profesional/becas) and exposes no img logo at all, only a favicon.ico link, its header mark being an inline SVG. Following brief section 2.3 to the university's own official brand-asset page, https://videolab.tec.mx/es/formatos-descargables/identidad-institucional ('Identidad institucional'), whose navbar names the theme logo /themes/custom/tec/logo.svg - which on that host is the real 9835-byte Illustrator wordmark rather than a stub. Host check: videolab.tec.mx is a subdomain of the shard host tec.mx, so rule 1 is satisfied directly. That same official page also hosts 'Manual de uso del logotipo del Tecnologico de Monterrey' and ZIP logo packs, but those are Google Drive links, i.e. a third-party host, and are barred by rules 1 and 6. Rejected siblings from the same page: /sites/g/files/vgjovo1291/files/logo_tec.png (alt 'Logo Footer', 200 image/png 4569 bytes, but renders blank/white on a light background - it is the reversed footer variant); /sites/g/files/vgjovo1291/files/logo_videolabtec_fondo_obscuro_2.png (31546 bytes, renders as the orange 'LAB' wordmark - that is Videolab's own sub-brand, not Tecnologico de Monterrey, so it fails rule 2); and the page's carousel slide /sites/g/files/vgjovo1291/files/identidad-institucional.jpg, which is editorial photography rather than a logo.
